votes.motion: approve the minutes of the Capital Planning Committee meeting of September 29

joanna bilotta made a motion to adjourn the meeting. heather sroka seconded her motion, and the committee voted 5-0 to adjourn the meeting at 6:49 pm.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the October 21, 2014 meeting
votes.quote: the committee approved the minutes of the tuesday, october 21 cpc meeting.

votes.motion: Include Dennis statement of goals followed by Joanna's description of procedures on the Capital Planning Committee website
votes.quote: heather moved that the web site include dennis statement of goals, followed by joanna's description of procedures. dennis seconded her motion, and the committee approved the motion 5-0.
joanna moved to adjourn the meeting; heather seconded her motion, and the committee voted 5-0 to adjourn the meeting at 6:20 pm.

votes.motion: Approve the minutes of the Tuesday, November 04 CPC meeting
votes.quote: the committee approved the minutes of the tuesday, november 04 cpc meeting, 5-0.

votes.motion: The Sewer Commission could include any of their requests for technology equipment purchases in the Technology capital request plan, with the Sewer Commission reimbursing the Town for the cost of these purchases upon delivery
votes.quote: john moved that "the sewer commission could include any of their requests for technology equipment purchases in the technology capital request plan. however, the sewer commission will reimburse the town for the cost of these purchases upon delivery to the commission." dennis seconded the motion. the capital planning committee voted 4-0 in favor of this motion.
john moved to adjourn the meeting; dennis seconded his motion, and the committee voted 4-0 to adjourn at 6:46 pm.

heather moved to adjourn the meeting; john seconded her motion, and the committee voted 4-0 to adjourn at 5:57 pm.
